text_block_list.text: The season of the spring Classic races has finally arrived.

"...The Classic Triple Crown route, the Triple Tiara route.
How an Umamusume and her Trainer spend this once-in-a-lifetime period is crucial, but—"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-chan.
You're looking at those documents again~

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it about time you paid
some attention to Maya~?

However, now that I've made a promise to her,
I must give careful thought, particularly regarding
the races she enters.

I need to expose her to various opportunities
where she has rivals and races
she can truly be interested in—
(Tap, tap)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hm? Who could that be...?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yoo-hoo! Mayano!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Teio-chan♪
What is it? Did you come to hang out?
(She's Tokai Teio. An Umamusume who looks up to the student council president, Symboli Rudolf, and also happens to be Mayano Top Gun's roommate.)

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, something like that!
The Prez actually handed me the footage, you see.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: "Teio. If you yearn for me, look not only at me, but also at those around me."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Like... 'watching Narita Brian run,'
for example. But watching it alone wouldn't be as fun, right?"

Narita Brian—she is an Umamusume
who boasts overwhelming power.

The Classics... Renowned as a "Triple Crown Umamusume"
who conquered the entire Triple Crown route among them.

She belongs to an older generation than Mayano Top Gun, so they're unlikely to compete in a real race anytime soon,
but as she takes on the upcoming Classic races—
choice_data_list: We should probably check it out.
Maybe we should check it out.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Oh, nice~!
Is Mayano's Trainer interested too?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh?! Trainer-chan?!
I told you, two-timing is totally NOT okay~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, sounds good! If Mayano's curious too,
let's all watch it together!

And so I ended up watching footage of
Narita Brian's races with them...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
In the lead is Narita Brian!
She's completely broken away!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: What tremendous legs! A monster! Utterly dominant!! Overpowering the other Umamusume, she crosses the fiiiniiiish liiine!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Coming around the fourth corner, here she comes as expected!
From the outside, she's sweeping past the entire pack in one fell swoop!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Is there no girl who can match Brian!?
Tearing away from the field, she crosseees the finish liiine!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: For her, there was no longer any other path!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"A race truly worthy of a Triple Crown Umamusume!
Narita Brian, what a magnificent run!"

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: Commentary booth! Commentary booth! Narita Brian has arrived here on the scene!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: Another brilliant victory! Did you already feel confident of your win before the race even began—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Is that how it looked to you?

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes! After all, it's Brian-san!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Even if you knew,
what difference would it make?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I merely run to fulfill myself.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
A race is nothin' but a gathering of
Umamusume starving for victory.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"That is precisely why I shall leave everyone in the dust.
To quench this thirst of mine."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —Next time, too.
—Along the Triple Crown route, there are famous maxims for each of the G1 races.

"The Satsuki Sho—the fastest wins.
The Japanese Derby—the luckiest wins.
The Kikuka Sho—the strongest wins."
However, seeing Narita Brian run this time, her strength was such that she silenced everything with raw, off-the-charts power.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Nothin' really~ Just felt like calling your name!
Saying so, Mayano Top Gun turned her attention back to the TV screen.

—If there had been an opponent like Narita Brian
in this year's Classic campaign,
would something have already changed by now?
...And then came the next day.

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
"Can an Umamusume really be this strong?!
—Narita Brian claims the first crown!!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-chan, are you still watching?
Brian-san's race, I mean.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I promised Teio-chan I'd return it next week,
so isn't it fine if I don't watch it right this second?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Mmmghhh...!!
—Yet, I couldn't take my eyes off her.
I wondered what it would be like if Mayano Top Gun had a rival like her right now...
(――*snap*)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
No waaaay! No no no, no waaay!!
Trainer-chan, look at meee!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Maya isn't having any fun right now!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Because you're excited right now too,
aren't you, Trainer-chan?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I don't want that! Because Trainer-chan is Maya's Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I want you to be thrilled by Maya's running,
not Brian-san's!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Brian-san is certainly strong!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"When we run together, it's so thrilling and full of sparkle!
Even I can tell that much!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Maya used to think the exact same thing before her debut, you know!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...Still, Maya's already debuted!
I understand way, way more about everything!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
With how Maya is right now,
I can get strong enough to whooosh right past Brian-san!
...Indeed, even if we cannot compete directly right now.

Chasing after her as a goal
might serve as good motivation for Mayano Top Gun.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
It's true, you know!
I'm gonna beat Brian-san in no time flat!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Then, will you look only at Maya
and praise me, saying, "That was so thrilling!"?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Will you tell me that I looked sparkling,
and that Maya was number one?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Then it's officialll!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya is serious! Totally and completely!
Be prepared for it! You copy!?

...She's putting an unusual amount of effort into it, but
like this—

On this day, a new goal was born within her:
"Narita Brian."
